author: GamingBolt
description:
With a new GTA game inching ever closer to its final release, we’ve been quite busy looking at how far the franchise has come over the years ahead of diving into the new adventure it’s offering. That tendency to ruminate brought us to GTA 3, a title that’s is now twenty-five years old. There are many reasons for us to revisit this classic, and it's a milestone for the franchise in many ways.

But is it worth playing through again, after several sequels and a lot of modern additions that subsequent titles have as advantages over it? Well, it’s still a surprisingly potent experience if you can look past some problems that its age now brings to the table. We’ve elaborated on it all, so join us on this very interesting trip down memory lane.
title: Grand Theft Auto 3 - 25 Years Later, Is It Still Worth Playing?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Phantom Blade Zero is now so close we can almost hear the blades clashing on the battlefield in our heads. We’re excited, to be sure, but there’s also been a bit of apprehension bout how Soul could be convinced to stop and help anyone offering an opportunity for some side content in the game, considering the circumstances that are driving him forward through the main story.

That concern is what we’re tackling here, as we take a look at an interesting dilemma for S-GAME and the many ways in which it could tackle the problem of a man on a mission being convinced to think about others who need his assistance. Join us for another interesting trip through the Wulin ahead of a game that’s poised to make a big splash when it comes along.
title: Phantom Blade Zero - What Is Worth Doing When You Have 66 Days Left?
